The main takeaway from our work is that
the kink instability and transverse disruption of the electron beam are not a major concern.
the electron beam current and size fluctuations should be controlled to be less than 1% and 0.1%, respectively.
the kink instability and emittance growth can be suppressed by a proper choice of the electron beam energy and the electron beam size.
